answer: A farm of 348 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in lagoon, queued in anchor, and zephyr publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 89 identities per epoch. A farm of 2005 identities would post 2159 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
